output.title: Contemporary 3-Bedroom Apartment with Balcony and City Views in Kirchberg
output.description:
This newly built apartment offers 145 m² of refined living space characterized by modern design and high-quality finishes. The open-plan living area features south-facing windows and a double-height ceiling that enhance the abundant natural light, creating a spacious and inviting atmosphere. Engineered wood flooring adds warmth to the living and dining areas, which flow seamlessly.

The kitchen is equipped with Bulthaup cabinetry and a central island with a breakfast bar, complemented by an induction cooktop and stone worktop surfaces. Its minimalist aesthetic provides a functional and stylish space for culinary activities. From the living area, access to a balcony provides tranquil views over Kirchberg park, separated by a glass balustrade and tiled flooring, suitable for relaxation or morning coffee.

Two modern bathrooms, including a spa-like ensuite, are appointed with walk-in rain showers, double vanities, porcelain tiles, and underfloor heating, contributing to comfort and a sense of understated luxury. Additional features include an elevator within the building, a parking space, and a cellar that offers separate storage.

Situated in Kirchberg, Luxembourg’s contemporary business district, this apartment benefits from views over the parkland and proximity to institutions including the EU quarter and cultural venues like the Philharmonie and MUDAM. The neighborhood is characterized by modern architecture and international educational facilities, reflecting the area's dynamic urban environment.

highlights.text: South-facing spacious living room with double-height ceiling
Bulthaup kitchen with induction cooktop and stone worktop
Two bathrooms featuring walk-in rain showers and underfloor heating
Newly built in Kirchberg business district
